title: HSWM giant LLM and executable hypergraph world-model research harness

authority.purpose: Turn the user-primary identity into falsifiable mathematical, philosophical, scientific, and modern-AI gates without claiming that the target already exists.
does_not_supersede: EFFICACY.md and its checked-in direct measurements
F1 runbook, preregistration, operator, and judge authority

thesis.one_line_ko: LLM 함수 셀 → 연산자형 HSWM layer → 하나의 거대 LLM; 그 망의 지속 상태와 전이는 실행형 하이퍼그래프 월드모델이다.
thesis.one_line_en: LLM function cells connected by an operator-valued HSWM layer form one giant system-level LLM whose persistent state and transitions constitute an executable hypergraph world model.
system_equations: c_i^(t+1) = LLM_i(role_i, contract_i, x_i^t, messages_i^t, memory_i^t)

layers.meaning: An LLM invocation is a typed, stateful semantic function cell rather than the whole agent system.
Hyperedges carry relation, transport, gating, efficacy, uncertainty, and fast/slow plastic state; W is not merely one scalar ranking score.
The system-level input-output map and persistent macro-state belong to the whole LLM network, not to any single member model.
The graph is executable state: local rewrites produce events, causal lineage, predictions, and control-relevant counterfactuals.
Receipts and verdicts assign credit to W and topology under explicit fast/slow stability constraints.
Calling the whole network a giant LLM requires a causally useful macro-description, not only coordinated messages.

claim_boundary.allowed_current_claim: HSWM is a coherent and testable research programme for a system-level giant LLM with an executable hypergraph world model. Existing X0/X2/X3 results support only scoped substrate, credit, and topology components; they do not yet establish the giant-LLM or world-model identity.
forbidden_overclaims: HSWM has already been shown to be one giant LLM.
HSWM has already been shown to learn a predictive world model.
A collection of LLM agents is automatically a neural network or group agent.
A static knowledge graph, RAG index, or message log is an executable world model.
Operator-valued notation alone proves useful causal transport.
Wolfram-like hypergraph rewriting implies Wolfram's claims about fundamental physics.
System-level agency implies consciousness, rights, or moral personhood.
Exploratory development results close an unsealed scientific gate.
bright_lines: giant_LLM means a system-level network function and macro-state, not fused Transformer parameters
Wolfram_like means hypergraph state plus local rewrite and causal lineage, not fundamental physics
neural_network means learned causal connectivity and plasticity, not a hand-written workflow graph
world_model means transition-predictive and intervention-useful state, not retrieval-only memory
group_agent means a defensible causal/functional macro-agent, not voting or chat alone

gates.title: LLM invocation behaves as a typed function cell
gates.claim: Each LLM node has an explicit typed port, local state, and intervention semantics that make it a replaceable semantic function cell.
gates.operational_test: Freeze model, prompt contract, budget, and inputs; intervene on one typed cell or port and verify predictable local and downstream changes while invalid types fail closed.
strongest_baselines: untyped message bus with the same models and token budget
gates.falsifier: Cell replacement, port intervention, or type removal produces no reproducible causal difference beyond ordinary prompt variation.
gates.next_action: Specify a minimal typed-cell intervention receipt and attach it to the existing X1/F1 lane without changing its judge.

gates.title: Operator-valued HSWM layer does unique causal work
gates.claim: Typed hyperedges and W transport information and control better than flat, pairwise, shuffled, removed, and fixed-layer agent systems under equal budgets.

markers: LLM은 주체가 아니라 거시 신경망의 의미적 활성화 함수

gates.operational_test: Use the registered X1/F1 causal intervention design with equal model, token, latency, and retrieval budgets; compare typed/operator HSWM against direct LLM, fixed MoA, optimized graph, flat vector, removal, and shuffle controls.
gates.falsifier: Any strongest baseline matches or exceeds HSWM inside the preregistered equivalence or superiority margin, or causal edge interventions are flat.
gates.next_action: Complete the existing sealed X1/F1 measurement; do not create a parallel judge or infer closure from this harness.

gates.title: The whole network is a causally useful giant LLM
gates.claim: The network admits a stable macro-state, goals or control variables, and interventions whose predictive power is not reducible to a list of individual agent messages.

markers: 합의 포함 더 큰 AI — OPEN

gates.operational_test: Define a macro-state and policy before evaluation; test whether macro-interventions predict or control held-out network behavior better and more compactly than micro-message traces, committees, or a central router.
strongest_baselines: full micro-trace model with no macro-state
gates.falsifier: The proposed macro-state adds no out-of-sample predictive or control value, is unstable under equivalent decompositions, or merely renames the router state.
gates.next_action: Write a macro-agent causal-abstraction preregistration only after G1 yields a non-flat typed-network signal.

gates.title: Hypergraph state is an executable world model
gates.claim: H_t supports local rewrite, causal lineage, counterfactual transition prediction, and control-relevant rollout rather than retrieval alone.
gates.operational_test: On a partially observed environment, freeze an event schema and local rewrite rule; measure held-out next-state prediction, counterfactual intervention accuracy, planning/control gain, causal provenance, and update-order sensitivity against retrieval-only and learned world-model baselines.
gates.falsifier: The hypergraph cannot predict transitions or support interventions beyond retrieval, causal lineage is not replayable, or update-order effects are neither invariant nor explicitly modeled.
gates.next_action: Build a tiny deterministic rewrite world with hidden interventions and preregister prediction/control metrics before adding more agents.

gates.title: Receipts and verdicts drive stable W and topology plasticity
gates.claim: Outcome-informed credit updates fast/slow W and topology in a way that improves future behavior without unstable drift.
gates.operational_test: Run prequential held-out evaluation with frozen receipts; compare outcome credit, random credit, verbal-only feedback, placebo updates, W shuffle, and topology shuffle while tracking regret, drift, retention, and fast/slow convergence.
gates.falsifier: Updates do not improve held-out future behavior, gains disappear under negative controls, or fast/slow dynamics diverge or catastrophically forget.
gates.next_action: Bind existing X2/X3 receipts to one prequential fast/slow stability experiment; keep the full-loop claim open.

gates.title: Native n-ary structure survives the clique baseline
gates.claim: Some HSWM tasks require native n-ary relations whose semantics and causal effects cannot be preserved by pairwise clique expansion under equal budgets.
gates.operational_test: Construct powered clique-collision tasks where pairwise projection provably aliases distinct n-ary relations; compare native hyperedges with degree-, parameter-, token-, and latency-matched clique and factor-graph controls.
gates.falsifier: Clique or pairwise controls match or exceed native hyperedges on powered collision tasks; then n-ary uniqueness remains killed and HSWM must retreat to graph-level claims.
gates.next_action: Do not relabel the existing kill; design one clique-collision testbed before spending on broader n-ary claims.

gates.title: HSWM layers compose without semantic drift
gates.claim: Open HSWM subsystems compose through typed boundaries while preserving identity, associativity up to canonical form, causal provenance, and behavioral semantics.
gates.operational_test: Property-test identity and associativity up to canonical normalization; verify a semantic map from composed structure to observable traces, including provenance and failure propagation.
gates.falsifier: Equivalent composition orders change observable semantics unexpectedly, ports leak hidden state, or provenance cannot be replayed across boundaries.
gates.next_action: Add algebraic property tests to the existing open-composition implementation before claiming self-similar closure.

gates.title: The programme survives adaptive and external validation
gates.claim: HSWM identity claims survive preregistration, construct validation, negative controls, multi-seed uncertainty, and independent replication.
gates.operational_test: Preregister construct, estimand, strongest baseline, power, seeds, stopping rule, and negative controls; use untouched holdout and an external operator to reproduce the sealed receipt.
gates.falsifier: The effect disappears on untouched holdout or external replay, measurement does not identify the intended construct, or negative controls fire.
gates.next_action: Keep this harness diagnostic-only; scientific closure remains owned by preregistered experiment-specific judges.
